legend.frozen: Frozen: computed from games before 2026-11-02 only, ratings fixed at that cutoff, committed 2026-11-10 (code at tag pred-2026-preQF, output in 08e0ebe) after the quarterfinals had started, and never re-run.
legend.walk_forward: Walk-forward: computed afterwards. Each game is predicted from games dated before it, with results added game by game; H and the decay weights are fixed at the start of each Worlds, and k_league was chosen on the 2023-24 results. Not a live prediction.
legend.sensitivity: Sensitivity: the frozen run repeated after the fact with one assumption changed (who holds the side choice in quarterfinal game 1). A what-if.

derivation_text.saved: Saved in the frozen prediction file on 2026-11-10.
derivation_text.computed_from_frozen_inputs: Computed at export time (2026-11-12) from the frozen inputs (same ratings, H, q and sigma) by score.py; not saved on 2026-11-10.
derivation_text.walk_forward_replay: Replayed after the event, using only earlier games.
